desc.zh: 从两片纸条到区间动态规划：逐个切口验证两侧的合法对应。
desc.en: Derive interval dynamic programming by testing both child alignments at each split.

concepts.name: recursive string partition
concepts.description: Split contiguous nonempty pieces and independently keep or swap.

concepts.name: interval dynamic programming
concepts.description: Two start positions and a shared length identify a reusable Boolean state.

concepts.name: inductive correctness
concepts.description: Both root alignments are necessary and sufficient when their child states are correct.
